subject: Covenant Health SIG clarifications & artifact delivery plan
messages:
From: Lori Shaw <procurement@covenant-health.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: Jayshree Patel <security@covenant-health.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Covenant Health SIG questionnaire - clarifications and sample artifacts request

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the SIG questionnaire submission last week. A couple of clarifying asks from our security and procurement teams before we route to legal:

- Can you confirm which SOC 2 report (Type I/Type II) you intend to provide and the period covered?
- For ISO 27001, please share the certificate and the scope statement.
- We need a small sample of production access logs (redacted) that demonstrate retention and deletion practices (13 months minimum).
- Key management: provide an example key-rotation proof or log.
- Is there an option for a VPC/private deployment for PHI workloads? If yes, outline the controls that differ from hosted.

Timeline: procurement needs the artifacts and scope clarifications by EOD Friday to keep our internal review on schedule.

Also include a point of contact for any technical walkthroughs; security may request a short call.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Lori
Lori Shaw
Sr. Sourcing Manager, Covenant Health
procurement@covenant-health.com

[Attachment: Covenant_SIG_Questions_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-10-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Covenant Health SIG questionnaire - clarifications and sample artifacts request

Hi Lori — thanks for the clear list. Quick responses below and an initial delivery plan.

Summary answers:
- SOC 2: we will provide SOC 2 Type II (most recent audit covering 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30).
- ISO: attaching current ISO 27001 certificate and scope statement.
- Logs: will provide a redacted access-log sample covering authentication and data-access events (we will redact PII before delivery).
- Keys: attaching a sample key-rotation CSV that shows rotation timestamps and operator IDs (redacted).
- VPC/private deployment: yes — Redwood Private (VPC) is available for PHI. Differences are noted in the control mapping (network isolation, customer-managed KMS, audit forwarding).

Proposed artifact delivery plan (timeline):
1) Today (EOD): SOC 2 summary + ISO cert + control-mapping workbook (high level).
2) Tomorrow: redacted access-log sample + key-rotation sample + link to a scoped telemetry dashboard.
3) Friday EOD: full SIG control map (SIG->SOC2/ISO crosswalk) and a short recording walk-through if helpful.

Point of contact for the technical walkthrough: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai (security architect).

Attachments included in this message: 1) iso27001-certificate.pdf (pdf) 2) sig-control-mapping.xlsx (xlsx) 3) redwood-service-overview.pdf (pdf)

If there are particular control families you want us to prioritize (e.g., cryptography, change management, logging), flag them and we will accelerate.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai

From: Jayshree Patel <security@covenant-health.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Lori Shaw <procurement@covenant-health.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T14:32:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Covenant Health SIG questionnaire - clarifications and sample artifacts request

Hannah / Karthik — thanks for the quick replies and for the ISO cert. A few clarifications before we accept the sample:

- SOC 2: we require Type II covering at least a continuous 6-month testing window. Your stated window is acceptable; please include the auditor name and the report attestation page.
- Logs: retention policy check — we expect demonstration that logs are retained 13 months and immutable for the retention period. A sample plus a retention policy excerpt would be helpful.
- Key rotation: we need an explanation of who can rotate keys and the approval flow; the sample CSV is fine but annotate the CSV with column definitions.
- VPC/private: can you specify if customer-managed KMS is supported for Private deployments and whether HSM-backed keys are an option?

Also: will you be able to sign an NDA for any PII-containing artifacts if we need larger samples? We prefer an NDA before exchanging anything with even minimal PHI in it.

Timeline: procurement still wants a package by EOD Friday. If that is not possible, let us know what you can do by that deadline and what requires extra review.

Thanks — Jayshree
Director, Information Security
Covenant Health
security@covenant-health.com
[Attachment: Covenant_SIG_Acct_Info.pdf (pdf)]

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>

Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-20T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Covenant Health SIG questionnaire - clarifications and sample artifacts request

Jayshree / Lori — appreciation for the follow-ups. Final package and notes below; we can stage under an NDA if you prefer.

What we are delivering by Friday EOD (staged, redacted where required):
- redacted-soc2-typeii-summary.pdf — includes auditor name (Clearwater Audit LLP) and attestation page excerpt.
- iso27001-certificate.pdf — scope includes Redwood Inference hosted and private control plane, limited to inference services and control plane components.
- sig-control-mapping.xlsx — complete SIG->SOC2/ISO crosswalk with notes on Private deployment differences.
- access-logs-sample-2025.zip — sample auth + object-access logs (PII redacted). README in ZIP explains redaction and retention proof points.
- key-rotation-sample.csv — annotated; includes rotation timestamps, key IDs, and a column describing approval flow (operator ids redacted).

Notes on Private (VPC) and KMS:
- Redwood Private supports customer-managed KMS via integration with AWS KMS or customer HSMs. Customers can bring their own keys using an envelope encryption pattern; we can enable HSM-backed keys through supported partners.
- Controls that differ: network egress restrictions, private peering, and explicit customer KMS ownership. These are flagged in the SIG mapping workbook.

NDA & PHI: we are happy to sign Covenant's standard NDA before exchanging additional artifacts that contain PHI. For the samples we are delivering Friday, everything with potential PHI has been redacted; if you need longer-term, unredacted access for validation we request an executed NDA plus a scoped acceptance environment.

Delivery & access: artifacts will be staged to a secure signed S3 link and a short README will explain redaction methodology and which log fields were removed. Link and Doc index: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3cCovenantSIGDraft

Proposed next steps:
- Confirm whether you need a short technical walkthrough (30 min) — if yes, propose Tue/Wed next week.
- If NDA required before Friday for additional artifacts, please send; otherwise we will proceed with the redacted package.

Thanks again — we'll follow up when the staging is ready.

Best regards,
Hannah Schmitt
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
